title: Translucent acorn-shaped craft over fisherman pulling up nets

tellings.quote: one guy said, the guy who drew on the acrylic chalkboard said that he was pulling up his nets at night. And as he was doing that, it was like he said like somebody turned the lights on or the sun suddenly came up and he looks up and 30, 40 feet above him is one of these craft

plain: In 2023, a fisherman in the Alto Nanay region of the Peruvian Amazon is said to have been pulling up his nets at night when it was suddenly as if 'somebody turned the lights on or the sun suddenly came up', and he looked up to see a translucent craft shaped like an acorn hovering 30 or 40 feet above him. The researcher and filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels this from his own visit to the area, where the fisherman drew the craft for him on an acrylic chalkboard. Alberino raises it as one of several local reports of the same kind of craft.
